a:r.a:t: ChREBP Activates Transcription in Response to Glucose

p:cNvPr.descr: A diagram of the mechanism of gene regulation by the transcription factor ChREBP. This image has two boxes on top of each other. The top box is purple and entitled cytosol; the bottom box is blue and entitled nucleus. At the top of the cytosol box, there is a yellow line going across, outlined in blue, representing plasma membrane.The top left of the box begins with glucose, with a blue image breaking through the plasma membrane labeled "GLUT 2." That image has an arrow pointing down to glucose, with hexokinase IV (glucokinase) [in blue] in the middle of the arrow. The arrow points to glucose 6-phosphate, which has three small arrows pointing down to xylulose 5-phosphate, which has a dashed arrow pointing down then right to a green rectangle in a circle, with PP2A written in blue to the right of it. Above the PP2A is a white oval labeled ChREBP, that has two black Ps in red circles darting out at the top left and top right. A black arrow points down to another white oval with ChREBP, but also has an arrow pointing right to P1. This oval also has a black P in a red circle darting from its top left. An arrow points from this oval down and breaks into the nucleus box, pointing to another white oval with ChREBP and the black P in a red circle darting from the top left. This oval has an arrow pointing down to another white oval with ChREBP and also has an arrow pointing right to P1. In the middle of the arrow pointing down is PP2A (in blue). To the left of that is a green triangle in a circle that has a dashed arrow pointing to it from xylulose 5-phosphate. From the bottom white oval ChREBF there is a black arrow pointing right with a purple oval on top of it entitled Mlx. The arrow points to four sideways ovals in a row: The first is a white ChREBP oval; the second is a purple Mlx oval; the third is a white ChREBP oval; and the fourth is a purple Mlx oval. These four ovals are stacked on a blue box entitled ChoRE, which has a small arrow going up then to the right pointing to a wavy green arrow called mRNA. From the wavy green arrow are two black arrows pointing up. These arrows are solid until they break through to the cytosol box, then become dashed. One arrow points to [up arrow] fatty acid sythesis. The other arrow points to [up arrow] glycolysis.
